title: P15.9-A2 production default Company Cockpit cutover with explicit legacy rollback
description: BASE bdeae5aa651cbfb586ed23a1dd09ff448dda0730. Executed: tsc clean, vite build clean, Playwright 193/217 on production dist; b6-acceptance 8/8 green incl. / -> /app/company, id/query/hash preservation, 'legacy' rollback.
